items.requirement: Gold purity: confirm the karat (10K, 14K, 18K, etc.)
items.online: Yes — karat is printed on every listing in the table
items.note: Recorded from the listing's metal field; the exact quote is stored per row.

items.requirement: Solid gold: the listing must explicitly say solid gold — not plated, vermeil, filled, overlay or tone
items.online: Only partly — 2 of 9 listings explicitly say 'solid gold'
items.note: Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth and Ross-Simons list karat only. Flagged F-006; get written confirmation from the seller.

items.requirement: Hallmark: a 10K/14K/18K stamp plus a maker's/manufacturer's mark
items.online: No — no listing page states the hallmark or maker's mark
items.note: Flagged F-005. Must be seen on the ring (or in a close-up photo) and confirmed by an independent jeweler.

items.requirement: Weight: the ring's weight in grams
items.online: No — 0 of 9 listings published a gram weight in captured HTML
items.note: Flagged F-004/F-013. Ask the seller for the weight of the exact size and metal before paying.

items.requirement: Seller reputation: independent reviews/complaints and real contact information
items.online: Partly — contact phone/email verified for 3 of 5 sellers; BBB lookup links provided
items.note: No review rating is republished here. Mejuri contact details were not captured (F-011); BBB profiles are linked for manual review.

items.requirement: Price: compare with gold weight and current gold value; an unusually cheap price is a red flag
items.online: Partly — prices and spot captured; weights are missing, so price-per-gram cannot be computed
items.note: Use the calculator with a seller-confirmed weight. Setting-only prices exclude the centre stone (F-015).

items.requirement: Return policy, including exclusions for resized/custom rings
items.online: Yes — return windows and exclusions captured for all five sellers
items.note: All five exclude resized and/or personalised items from returns. Details and quotes on the Sellers page.

items.requirement: Payment: prefer a credit card; avoid irreversible methods
items.online: Partly — financing is advertised, but no seller's full accepted-card list was captured
items.note: Pay by credit card at checkout so chargeback protection applies; this is a checklist rule, not a claim about a seller's payment page.

items.requirement: Documentation: keep the listing, receipt, description and purity claims
items.online: Yes — every row links to the official page with a capture date
items.note: Save a PDF/screenshot of the live page at purchase time; pages change (F-002, F-003).

items.requirement: On arrival: independent jeweler verifies purity and weight before wearing/resizing
items.online: No — this is an offline step
items.note: Unresizable or resized rings may lose return eligibility, so inspect first.

items.requirement: Best verification: XRF testing or another professional purity test; do not rely on the stamp alone
items.online: No — this is an offline step
items.note: Ask for the XRF readout in writing, with the machine's calibration check.

items.requirement: If the seller will not allow independent verification or a return, do not buy
items.online: No — a decision rule for you at checkout
items.note: All five sellers publish a return window; confirming it for the exact item is still required.
